source.title: Constructed exercise (not from a publication): a methane compressor from 1 bar to 5 bar
source.note: every input is my choice, flagged assumed. The topic comes from the IIT Kharagpur NPTEL course plan (Principles and Practices of Process Equipment and Plant Design, week 10: plant hydraulics, pumps and compressors); the lectures are videos and their transcripts could not be reached, so none of their content or numbers is used

reported.name: compressor_duty
reported.anchor: independent: CoolProp methane, isentropic enthalpy rise divided by 0.75 (DWSIM default, to be confirmed by the run)

reported.name: outlet_T
reported.anchor: independent: outlet enthalpy at the outlet pressure, same efficiency

tolerance.note: duty and outlet temperature 3 percent, fixed before the run; the paper package (Peng-Robinson) is itself my assumption; Raoult's Law is listed to show what an ideal-gas package gives

scenarios.why: the same compressor to 10 bar (independent calculation)

review.method: independent isentropic and isenthalpic calculations with CoolProp
